notes.title: 0.5.0.0 is available on PC and MAC OS!
notes.content:
Hi! We update Dark Minute to version [b]0.5.0.0 on PC and MAC OS[/b]! I hope you like it!

[h3]0.5.0.0[/h3]
===========================
MAJOR CHANGES:
- fixed sound FX and music in the game.
- now sound on/off in MAIN MENU is working correct.
- fixed saving options in MAIN MENU.
- better water diving system.
- walls fixed (now you can't jump on static walls).

MINOR CHANGES:
- level 9 minor bugs fixed with walls and folowwing drone.
- level 14 - walls bug fixed and fireball bug fixed.
- blowing block's now respawns when Kira died.
- following drone now respawns on starting position when Kira died.
- following drone now is flying only 20 seconds.
- improvement of Kira's death system.
- game HUD is now scallable for lower resolutions.
- improvement animations and system in levels' end.
- now game pause when you disconnect joypad/controller in game.
- other levels minor bugs fixed (small redesign).

This week we add new levels.

If you see bug - please tell us.

Best!
Lucas / koval.games
